items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Then I made so many records with Roy, 'Braggin' In Brass,' all those things. Roy, Charlie Shavers, Joe Thomas.

ctx.x: You mentioned Roy Eldridge. Let's talk about him for a while.

Roy, we made all his records with Billie Holiday together. Roy, Benny Goodman, Ben, Teddy Wilson, Kirby. We made the first records, 'Miss Brown to You,' 'What a Little Moonlight Can Do.' Roy was on those. Then I made so many records with Roy, 'Braggin' In Brass,' all those things. Roy, Charlie Shavers, Joe Thomas.
